prompt_en:
Goal: Create a bright Japanese skincare advertising banner for a daily-use sunscreen, with an airy luxury cosmetic feel and soft morning sunlight.

Canvas: Wide horizontal web banner, 1200×675 px, 16:9 aspect ratio. Use a very pale blue-white color palette, high-key lighting, soft shadows, and a clean minimalist Japanese beauty-ad aesthetic.

Layout: Split the composition into three main zones: left product hero, center typography and feature icons, right lifestyle model. On the left, place one tall transparent cylindrical pump bottle standing on a glossy reflective surface, occupying about 25% of the width. In the center, place large handwritten Japanese headline text in soft blue. On the right, show a young woman in a white camisole near a bright window, cropped from chest upward, turned slightly toward the camera; her face is covered by a large opaque beige square privacy block, while hair, ear, neck, shoulders, and upper chest remain visible. Background should be a sunlit white room with blurred window frames and a hint of green plant on the far right.

Product details: The bottle is clear glass/plastic with a frosted white sunscreen liquid inside, a shiny silver cylindrical cap, and delicate blue label typography. The bottle label should include: “SPF 50+”, “PA++++”, “UV PROTECTION SUNSCREEN”, “Daily Use UV Protector”, and “50mL / 1.69 FL.OZ.” Add a tiny sun icon above the SPF text.

Text content: At the top left, add small Japanese copy “紫外線から、肌をもっと美しく。” with a small English subtitle “Daily use sunscreen” beneath it. Center headline: やさしく、つよく。. Bottom-center SPF claim: “SPF 50+ PA++++” in large blue text, plus a thin outlined rectangular label reading “国内最高基準値*”. Add a very small footnote below in pale blue, visually present but not overly legible.

Feature icons: Include exactly 3 small line icons beneath the headline, evenly spaced with thin vertical dividers: 1) sun icon with “UV” and Japanese label “強力UVカット”, 2) water droplet icon with label “うるおい 保湿ケア”, 3) sparkle icon with label “透明感 トーンアップ”. Use simple blue line art.

Model details: The model has soft brown hair tied loosely up with wispy strands near the ear and neck, fair luminous skin, delicate shoulder line, and a white camisole strap. Her face must be obscured by a perfectly rectangular solid beige overlay, roughly from forehead to chin and spanning most of the face area, color close to warm gray-beige.

Visual style: Photorealistic product-ad composite, soft bloom, gentle lens flare, cool blue shadows, natural daylight, glossy reflection under bottle, lots of negative space, refined Japanese cosmetics branding. Keep all typography light blue, thin, elegant, and clean. Avoid clutter, extra products, additional people, logos, watermarks, or harsh contrast.\

[Overall Style]
New Chinese-style graduation photo style popular on Chinese social media, featuring playful, agile, energetic, cute, and pleasing vibes. The image should look like a relaxed and fun set of creative graduation photos suitable for sharing, generally clean and bright with a subtle Chinese sweet aesthetic.

[Makeup]
Sweet and clear youth makeup. Light and transparent base with natural skin color. Eye makeup in light apricot pink, peach pink, or warm brown tones with soft eyeliner and naturally curled lashes. Peach or apple pink blush, and cream pink, peach, or coral lip color. Overall look should be young and lively.

[Hairstyle]
Natural extension of original hair length from uploaded photos, but prioritized for styles that fit graduation caps decorated with flowers.
- Long hair: Semi-updo, double side braids, low double buns, or soft updo with loose strands.
- Mid-length hair: Half-tied, double braids, or low position updo.
- Short hair: Tucked behind ears or French short curls with small flower caps.

Playful Hanfu graduation outfits in light green, pink-white, light yellow, or milk white colors. Lightweight fabrics with embroidery, wraps, wide sleeves, and pattern details. Must pair with a flower-decorated academic cap or graduation hat with minor tassels.

Clean and bright Chinese-style studio space with beige, warm white, or light wood backgrounds. Decorative elements include cherry blossom branches, small wooden tables, flower vases, books, and scrolls. Props include brushes, scrolls, and wooden quote boards using traditional Chinese calligraphy like 'Happy Graduation' or 'Bright Future'.

Soft and bright lighting, overall clear and gentle. Detailed fabric and accessory textures. A slight soft focus effect, but not sharp or commercial advertisement style.

[Fixed 4-Grid Shots]

title: 粉彩十二生肖女孩网格
author: 小小东
categories: 海报 / 传单,动漫 / 漫画,Q版 / 萌系,水彩,角色
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a delicate 12-panel zodiac character collection poster featuring twelve cute anime-style girls, one for each Western zodiac sign, in a soft watercolor storybook aesthetic.

Canvas: Vertical poster in a 3-column by 4-row grid, with exactly 12 equal square panels separated by thin white gutters. Use a pale cream paper background with subtle watercolor texture, gentle fading edges, and no text labels.

Visual style: Dreamy Japanese kawaii illustration, soft pastel palette, translucent watercolor washes, pencil-like sketch lines, airy composition, tiny sparkles, floral accents, plush animals, magical props, and a hand-painted children’s book feeling. Characters should have tiny closed or sleepy eyes, soft blush, small mouths, oversized wavy hair, frilly dresses or fantasy outfits, and peaceful poses. Keep the entire image light, gentle, and slightly hazy, with no harsh contrast.

Subject details: Depict exactly 12 zodiac-themed girls, one per panel, arranged left to right, top to bottom:
1. Aries: a peach-orange curly-haired girl with small ram horns, surrounded by warm orange brushstrokes, holding a fluffy lamb-like plush or companion.
2. Taurus: a brown-haired girl with bull horns, sitting among roses and soft cream flowers, holding a dessert or cake, with a cozy teddy-like animal nearby.
3. Gemini: two twin girls standing close together, one pink-haired and one blue-haired, surrounded by small floating cards or papers and sunflowers.
4. Cancer: a blue-haired girl under a coral-pink crab-shaped hood or umbrella, hugging a pillow, with several tiny orange crabs around her.
5. Leo: a golden-blonde girl wearing a small crown, holding a wand or scepter, with a cute lion plush beside her, warm yellow-orange tones.
6. Virgo: a brown curly-haired girl in a neat scholar or botanist outfit, sitting at a desk with an open botanical book, small jars, flowers, and tidy shelves behind her.
7. Libra: a lavender-haired girl holding golden balance scales, wearing a pale flowing dress, with delicate flowers and a small white bird nearby.
8. Scorpio: a dark purple-haired girl in a gothic floral outfit, surrounded by black-purple flowers and scorpion-tail shapes, elegant and mysterious but still cute.
9. Sagittarius: an orange-haired archer girl with a bow and arrow, wearing a light green skirt, with small wings or feather details and a tiny animal companion.
10. Capricorn: a gray-brown curly-haired mountain-goat girl with curved goat horns, wearing earthy layered clothes and a backpack, standing near rocks or mountains with a small goat companion.
11. Aquarius: a pale blue-haired girl pouring water from a vessel, surrounded by blue ribbons, bubbles, and swirling water shapes, wearing a white and blue flowing outfit.
12. Pisces: a blue-haired ocean girl with starfish and sea ornaments in her hair, holding or surrounded by two pastel fish, with watery translucent blue waves.

Customization: The collection theme is Western zodiac signs as cute anime girls. The art style is soft pastel watercolor kawaii anime illustration. The character mood is sleepy, gentle, dreamy, and innocent. The palette is pale peach, cream, lavender, sky blue, soft gold, and rose pink. The layout is 3 columns by 4 rows with 12 square panels.

Constraints: Include exactly 12 panels and exactly the 12 listed zodiac characters. Do not add text, logos, captions, watermarks, realistic faces, photorealism, or dark dramatic lighting. Maintain consistent chibi-inspired proportions and the same watercolor texture across all panels.\

title: 日本温度计日海报

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a vertical Japanese awareness poster for May 14, Thermometer Day, combining a clean educational infographic with a realistic model wearing a themed T-shirt.

Canvas: Tall vertical social-media poster, 9:16 aspect ratio, pale ice-blue background, soft clinical lighting, clean magazine-style layout, blue and red accent palette.

Main subject: On the right half, place a realistic young Japanese woman with a neat chin-length black bob haircut, facing forward from upper thighs up. Her face is intentionally obscured by a plain rectangular blur/mosaic block. She wears a fitted short-sleeve gradient T-shirt fading from sky blue on the left to pink/red on the right. The shirt text reads exactly: “5/14” on the first line, “温度計の日” large below, and “ドイツの物理学者 ファーレンハイトの誕生日” in small text underneath. She holds a white digital thermometer delicately near her shoulder in her right hand.

Top section: On the left, large Japanese headline text reads “5月14日は” and then “温度計の日”, with “温度計” in dark blue and “の日” in red. Add a small line-art thermometer icon above/right of the headline with “°C”. Subtitle below: “— 暮らしを支える、温度のものさし —”. Add a short explanatory paragraph in small Japanese text describing that May 14 is Thermometer Day, related to the German physicist Fahrenheit and the importance of temperature measurement for science, personal life, safety, and comfort.

Decorative icons: Include exactly 3 pale blue scientific/weather icons in the upper-middle left background: 1 vertical thermometer icon, 1 globe icon, and 1 laboratory flask icon.

Middle infographic section: Add a heading “温度計が活躍する場面” with a yellow underline. Beneath it, create exactly 3 rounded rectangular cards in a row, each with a blue outline, a small icon, a bold Japanese title, explanatory text, and a photo thumbnail:
1. Heart icon, title “健康管理に”, text about measuring body temperature and noticing changes early, thumbnail of a digital thermometer on a soft towel showing 36.5.
2. Cooking pot icon, title “料理・暮らしに”, text about cooking temperature control and bath temperature adjustment, thumbnail of a thermometer inserted into a steaming cooking pot.
3. Lab flask icon, title “研究・産業に”, text about accurate temperature measurement supporting technology and products, thumbnail of glass beakers/test tubes with a pipette.

Bottom section: Add a closing heading “温度を知ることは、未来を守ること” in dark blue, a thin horizontal rule, two lines of smaller Japanese explanatory text about climate awareness and protecting life and Earth’s future, and a final red call-to-action line: “今日は温度計に、ちょっと注目してみませんか?” Place a faint green-blue Earth-with-sprout icon at the bottom right.

Visual style: Clean Japanese public-information poster, realistic photography for the woman and card thumbnails, flat minimalist icons, soft shadows, rounded card corners, plenty of white space, professional print layout, no watermark, no extra logos. Use crisp readable Japanese typography and keep the exact visible section count: one top headline section, one model figure, three decorative icons, three application cards, and one bottom message section.\
